chapter: Danny's rise through New York bands to Cab Calloway
title: Staying in New York for Lu's career and women on the road
summary: Danny stayed in New York to promote his wife, who argued about women on the road, which he and Milt laugh about.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So that's that. I had wrote some songs, and people was telling me, "Why don't you promote your wife?" So I said, "Well, I'll stay in New York." Then you're staying away from home." See, my old lady don't come on the road with me, see, and then we'd get into arguments when I'd come home: "Where you been?", etcetera. "Have you got women out on the road?" -- which I did have. [LAUGHTER]
